summary: Conversational process isolation and bidirectional state URL synchronization standard

delivery.outcome: Standardize conversational stream purity and process isolation (NUL-007), bidirectional URL state synchronization (NUL-008), and conversational process snapshot introspection schema (NUL-009) proven in practice in willmux.
nonGoals: Alter execution runtime or container dispatch infrastructure
Break backward compatibility with existing RFC 3986 Process URI syntax
Mandate specific frontend frameworks or proprietary state stores

architecture.decision: Formalize the conversational process isolation and URL state synchronization pattern as normative rules NUL-007..009, provide the formal specification in spec/CONVERSATIONAL_PROCESS_ISOLATION.md, define the machine-verifiable JSON Schema wellmanifest.conversational-process-snapshot/v1, and add automated conformance tests.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-003 through protected delivery; legacy NUL-001..006 and semantic-v1 profiles remain active.

validation.evidence: Schema conformance for conversational process snapshot, URI/URN addressing, and bidirectional URL serialization tests pass.
Native governance check and worktree compliance pass without errors.
